There was. This is not a change to the functionality, however

When Goth Band was reprinted, you couldn't target your own cards via (D)
actions. This is how Goth Band functioned.

When the ruling on (D) actions was reversed (in amongst the 6/23 and 7/7
rulings), Goth Band's text was changed to preserve how it functioned
prior to that reversal.

Similarly, see Darius Styx (you can't target yourself) and Powerbase:
Mexico City (you can't steal it yourself), which were initially handled
in the same set of rulings. Text was changed as a result of the ruling
(which restored the integrity of a large number of cards).

Jyhad was originally written that (D) actions could target yourself in a
similar manner to their undirectedness now, from all signs. However, a
ruling was issued that (D) actions couldn't target yourself and that (D)
meant something different - it provided more options, rather than being
reminder text.

As such, cards in later sets were designed under this set-up. You could
never target yourself when Goth Band was designed and released.

When the ruling was over-turned, Goth Band would have had *new*
functionality that it could never have been designed for. Hence the
card-design preserving errata.

Please, do some research before defecating on the newsgroup.
